Temperature changes the sharpness of the probability distribution. Low temperature is more deterministic. High temperature is more random.
LoRA is a parameter-efficient finetuning method. It freezes the base weight and trains small low-rank update matrices.

instruction: What is routing collapse in MoE?
answer: Routing collapse happens when the router sends most tokens to the same expert. A load-balancing loss can reduce this problem.
